decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds directly on the firm's established trommel screening know-how and had positive market feedback, so the firm can keep interpreting results and refining it.
Mobile flail shredding sits close to the firm's mobile comminution competence, so it can draw on existing knowledge, although the lack of website evidence for 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.

The high-speed grinder uses related mobile grinding knowledge, which is especially valuable after the green-waste variant was withdrawn, but its weak visibility and the risk of portfolio consolidation keep withdrawal risk fairly high.

Single-shaft pre-shredders draw on core shredder expertise and support the strategic move into stationary plants, though stationary lines are further from the firm's mobile strengths and lack recent website evidence.
